recognition.settings.pointsBody: People earn points for what they learn, for tasks done on time and for thanks from colleagues; ten levels follow from them. Points are never money.
recognition.settings.pointsEnabledHint: Off: no points, levels or leaderboard; badges and thanks stay.
recognition.settings.taskPoints: Points for tasks done on time
recognition.settings.taskPointsHint: Routine work and given tasks, not personal ones; at most 10 a person a day.
recognition.settings.forStaffHint: The top ten and their own place. Managers always see everyone they see.
recognition.settings.scopeHint: Their branch keeps a small pharmacy's board fair next to a big one.
recognition.settings.kudosEnabledHint: From the app's (+) button and the bot's /kudos; the receiver gets points and a message.
recognition.settings.perDay: Thanks a person can give a day
recognition.settings.groupsHint: Groups that have the Kudos event on see each thank-you.
recognition.settings.tableBody: How many points each thing gives. A row you change keeps your number; the others follow the defaults.
